method: Resample saved fine_nominal FEM field at new nonmagnetic target plane. No new solve/remesh.
applicability: R05/R06 retains magnets and yoke; target/copper/fittings treated as mu_r=1. Ferromagnetic purchased parts, actual material properties, plasma and thermal effects omitted.
limits: Prior mesh/domain/analytical checks were for the baseline sampling region. They do not establish a new uncertainty bound at this plane or validate real hardware. No discharge, deposition, balance, thermal, seal or power rating is certified.
